notes.title: Steam China region re-launch message
notes.content:
The following information is about the re-launch of steam China region.

亲爱的《ICEY》玩家们，一直以来《ICEY》都想把感激的电波传达给你们。从2016年年末的PC版发售以来，时间已经过了近4年多了。期间在Steam上游戏一直是特别好评，这其中一定也有你的身迹。能得到玩家认可，是我们莫大的幸运。能在玩家口中相传，也让我们从工作成果中得到更多自信和认同感。

当初我们的《ICEY》的版号在2016年就办理完毕了。根据版署方面的要求，我们的游戏版号办理都严格符合要求细则，这也是我们游戏能顺利上架的原因。不过在当时对游戏版号要求细则中，规定了游戏可以多平台共用一个版号上架。我们填写的申报表格上，只勾选了其他，没有写PC或PS4。

2019年至今，因为版号政策调整的原因，游戏的版号要求变得更加严格，不得已我们只能下架国区一段时间。《ICEY》的PC版是在此政策调整前发售的，因此我们需要重新调整和补足手续，这其中有许多偶然成分，但主要还是自身手续方面的原因，不得已使我们与玩家暂时分别了一段时间。

现在，[b]艾希小姐姐总算能重返PC平台了[/b]，在此期间有不少玩家来心动网络的官方微博询问情况，我们深刻的感受到了玩家焦急的心情，在这里和大家说一声真的抱歉，玩家们等的实在太辛苦了。

能重新见面！真的很高兴，久等的玩家们，真的感谢你们的理解。毕竟这次手续调整影响到了玩家的游玩，[b]我们也将开启游戏的史低折扣6.5折[/b]，希望接下来的时间，游玩艾希的快乐能将这份小遗憾补足，谢谢，谢谢大家。

notes.title: Japanese Audio Fully Added and Discount Launched
notes.content:
Hey, folks! Guess we haven't met each other for a while. It's been two years since ICEY was released on STEAM. Many gratitudes for all your support and company while ICEY grew up with her team in the past two years.

Today, I am bringing some good news to everyone! Check our surprise for you guys here after a lapse of two years.

We are proud to announce that ICEY's selling on each platform has officially exceeded 2 million sets altogether. When the NS version of ICEY entered the Japanese market nearly two months ago, it was highly praised by Japanese gamers as well as reached the top best seller in Nintendo Eshop during the first half of June. On the App Store, the selling in Japanese region is only second 

after China by which we realized the great demand for Japanese audio.
Today, we brought a excellent Japanese audio update to Steam version with the highest discount in history. We hope that all of you who have bought or are willing to buy ICEY can experience our sincerity and care. Hope you enjoy these new content.

notes.title: We are nominated The Best Chinese Game at TGA 2017!
notes.content:
Friends of Steam, we have good news for you!

Just yesterday, when we were striving to fight off pirated games, we received some great news.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26877391/3bce6dcabad908717248a8427ef5f044db2d24f6.jpg[/img]

The 2017 TGA selection has begun, and ICEY has been nominated for the Best Chinese Game  
Click to find: http://thegameawards.com/awards/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26877391/96b9d7e7386f20f9bbadb23b24b510e45df7fd81.jpg[/img]

What is TGA? Allow me to explain.

What is TGA? TGA is... Well, it is like the Oscard in gaming. It is the highest award in the industry with a committee comprised of 63 world-famous media members. The 2017 TGA award ceremony will be held on December 7th, Pacific time. Same as last year, the TGA this year also has an award especially for Chinese gamers: (Best Chinese Game).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26877391/65e38cf2e00b927abd87a671238ca705bf9b6771.jpg[/img]

Other than ICEY, other nominations include Cuphead, Overwatch and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild. It is an honor for us to be nominated along with these great works. As for the awards that apply to games from all over the world, they are full of widely renowned games also.

To be listed in TGA means a great deal for any dev team. We have to thank you all for your support that allowed us to be nominated this time. Thank you.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26877391/31f442928be127de538d35c0a637ada441309100.jpg[/img]

Looking back to last year's nominations: League of Legends, Arena Of Valor, Fantasy Westward Journey, Onmyoji, and Battle of Balls. This year in TGA, indie games have gradually taken a foothold in the Best Chinese Game Award. We hope everyone can continue to support indie games. If you wish to vote, it is very easy. Just click on the Twitter icon marked by the red box in the images to vote.

Now, after sharing with you this great news, we are going to go back to making games. Please look forward to our upcoming games!

notes.title: Valve s Steam Link costs pennies in a bundle with Icey
notes.content:
I can only assume that Valve’s Steam Link box (which lets you play your PC stuff streamed to your TV in another room) hasn’t been flying off the shelves, given the discount it’s available for today. Whether it’s just to clear shelf-space or increase visibility, right now you can grab one for 80p plus postage as part of a bundle with well-received Chinese indie action game Icey, totalling 14.49 in all.

As I’d been meaning to pick up the game at some point – being a fan of character-action games and anime excess – I figured now was as good a time as any try my first piece of official Valve-branded hardware. That, and I’ve been looking for a cheap way to avoid lugging my desktop PC and its nest of cables to the TV whenever friends are round, so the price was right for me.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - ICEY, 10% off!
notes.content:
ICEY is Now Available on Steam and is 10% off!*

ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling ACT and a META game in disguise. As you follow the narrator's omnipresent voice, you will see through ICEY's eyes and learn the truth about her world. The narrator will constantly urge you in one direction, but you must ask, "Why? Why am I following his directions? Why can't I learn the truth about this world and ICEY's purpose here?" Fight against his tyranny, and uncover what's really going on for yourself!

Obey? Rebel?

*Offer ends November 24 at 10AM Pacific Time
